evidence.observedFact: The business lists an active Mentor location at 9420 Mentor Ave with current operating hours, a booking link, a contact form, phone 440-266-4247, and a link to its cancellation policy.

The business states that cancellations or reschedules made less than 24 hours in advance are subject to a $25 fee per service and that no-shows may be charged the full scheduled-service price, including any non-refundable deposit.

BBB publicly reports three complaints in the last three years and one complaint closed in the last 12 months for Jenniffer & Co. The complaint page includes disputes involving cancellation/deposit handling; the underlying customer allegations and business responses are conflicting claims, not treated here as independently verified facts.

gaps.recommendedFix: Demonstrate automated appointment reminders, cancellation-risk follow-up, waitlist/backfill workflows, and post-visit return triggers without changing the salon's published cancellation policy.
Demonstrate a review-recovery workflow that captures dissatisfaction privately, routes service-recovery follow-up, and requests public reviews from satisfied clients after completed visits.
